== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Uncle [[Fury]], also known as [[Akura Fury]], is a powerful [[Herald]] and a prominent member of the [[Akura clan|Akura family]]. He is the son of [[Malice]], born before she achieved the rank of [[Monarch]], and serves as the father to the [[Sage]] [[Charity]]. Despite being an ancestor to many in his lineage, he is the half-sibling of [[Mercy]] due to the vast span of centuries between them. He possesses a massive frame, glowing red eyes, and wild, shadowy hair that moves as if in an unseen current. [[Fury]] is characterized by a boisterous, infectious personality, often appearing with a wide grin or engaging in loud, wild laughter. He is known to be obsessed with combat and [[advancement]], frequently seeking out excitement and finding almost everything else boring. This passion for fighting has made him a significant enemy of dragon-kind, ranking closely behind [[Northstrider]] and the [[Beast King]] in that regard. In battle, he is a formidable force capable of using [[Abidan]] armor and [[Wolf Division]] techniques to supplement his honed abilities. He has achieved the rank of [[Icon]] and is recognized for his ability to use both [[madra]] and [[Way-power]]. While he often avoids duties that lack combat or personal growth, he is a central figure in the family's strength and history.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Uncle [[Fury]] possesses waving hair and blazing red eyes. His physical size and specific gestures are notable enough to remind others of [[Mercy]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A member of the [[Akura clan]], he held an affection for [[Mercy]]'s father. He is fundamentally incapable of listening to anything he deems boring and pushes [[Akura Pride|Pride]] to pursue [[advancement]] regardless of the cost.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Uncle [[Fury]] is the uncle of [[Mercy]] and [[Akura Pride{{!}}Pride]]. He maintained a friendship with [[Mercy]]'s father.}}
